:::{#def-new-observation}
#### New observation

A **new observation** $(\newpredvar, \newoutvar)$ relative to a [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$
is a covariate value and an outcome
drawn from the same population as the observations of $\trainset$,
and [statistically independent](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/independence.html#def-indpt) of $\trainset$.
The subscript $*$ marks a quantity of the new observation,
as in $\newpredvar$ and $\newoutvar$,
and distinguishes it from the indexed observations $(\vpredvar_{\iobs}, \outvar_{\iobs})$ of $\trainset$.
It is the [new observation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-new-observation) of the pds notes,
where the data used to choose the [prediction function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-prediction)
is $\trainset$,
to which a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) is applied.

:::
